summary: Contract satisfied on ff0f34f; process-environment UB removed by construction, AC-1..AC-8 met, docs complete. Approved with informational notes only.
notes: contract-check ok=true, zero violations; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (verified by hand, see notes below).
acceptance-coverage status=pass, zero gaps: AC-1..AC-8 all mapped to blueprint scenarios.

Limits respected: 12/14 files, 995/1500 lines; per-class crates/hexcell/src/** 444/450, crates/hexcell/tests/** 467/950, docs/** 84/250. The 12 changed files are exactly the contract touch list; no forbid glob matched, procesador.rs untouched.

AC-1 verified independently INSIDE worktrees/HEX-058 at ff0f34f (an earlier grep accidentally ran against the repo root on main and must be disregarded): repo-wide grep for set_var/remove_var over all *.rs returns zero hits; zero unsafe blocks remain under crates/hexcell (only a doc-comment mention at configuracion.rs:31); BLOQUEO_ENTORNO, CERROJO_DE_ENTORNO and limpiar_entorno_de_hexcell no longer exist anywhere.

AC-1 depth check: std::env::var is now called from exactly one site in the whole crate, configuracion.rs:56 inside EntornoDelProceso::leer. Every other std::env:: use under crates/hexcell is a read (temp_dir, args). No build.rs exists in the workspace and no env-writing dependency (dotenv/temp-env/figment/envy) is present, so no indirect writer can reintroduce the race. Command::env / env_clear in tests/configuracion.rs only populate the CHILD process environment and never the test process's own.

AC-2 evidence review (the implementer deleted a planned unit test to stay under the src/** 450-line cap): no PRE-EXISTING test was removed. tests/configuracion.rs has 18 tests before and after; the cfg(test) module in src/configuracion.rs has 1 test before and after. The dropped test was a new one that would have asserted desde_entorno reads the real environment, and it could not have been written soundly: exercising desde_entorno's happy path in-process requires writing the process environment, i.e. the exact UB this task removes.

AC-2 positive proof that desde_entorno still reads the real environment: tests/configuracion.rs:221 (el_binario_termina_antes_de_escuchar_si_falta_la_ruta_de_datos) spawns the real binary with env_clear() plus ONLY HEXCELL_ID_CELULA, and asserts stderr names HEXCELL_RUTA_DATOS. Because desde_fuente reads HEXCELL_ID_CELULA FIRST, the assertion can only hold if the binary genuinely read that variable from the process environment through main.rs -> desde_entorno -> EntornoDelProceso. This is a positive assertion, not merely a negative one, so the implementer's claim is verified.

AC-2 residual (informational, not blocking): only HEXCELL_ID_CELULA is proven end-to-end through the real environment; the remaining ~19 variable names are now exercised only through FuenteEnMemoria. Mitigated because tests/configuracion.rs asserts against literal strings ("HEXCELL_CANAL", "HEXCELL_EMBEDDINGS_PROVEEDOR", ...) rather than the module constants, so renaming a constant would still fail the suite, and EntornoDelProceso::leer is a one-line std::env::var(nombre).ok().

AC-2 semantics audit of all four reader groups: every Ok(v)/Err(_) pair became Some(v)/None with identical defaults, identical ErrorDeConfiguracion variants and identical empty-string guards. Non-UTF-8 values map to None, which reproduces the previous Err(_) arm exactly. leer_obligatoria keeps the trim-non-empty rule. desde_entorno survives as a thin wrapper and main.rs:87 still calls it unchanged.

AC-3 verified at motor.rs:519-535: create_dir_all's error now panics naming dir.display() and the error; GestorDePools::abrir's bare panic!() is replaced by a message carrying path and error. No `let _ =` swallowing remains in the touched helper.

AC-4 verified: SECUENCIA_DE_DIRECTORIOS is a module-level `static ... AtomicU64` (process-wide, not per-instance, not clock-derived) consumed with fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) at motor.rs:516; Relaxed is correct because a fetch_add RMW hands every caller a distinct value regardless of ordering. Combined with std::process::id() the name is unique within and across processes.

Injection shape honours the blueprint: the source is a constructor/function PARAMETER everywhere (Configuracion::desde_fuente, respaldar::ejecutar_cli, emparejar::ejecutar_cli, promocion's two renamed free functions plus drenar_epoca_superseida_de_conocimiento and purgar_epocas_de_conocimiento). No static, thread_local, OnceLock, lazy global or struct field holds it. main.rs:79 is the single composition root. FuenteEnMemoria and the trait are plain pub items, not behind cfg(test).
